cites.text: Before any executor spawn, run the tree check and the base check below.
Base check, when `Base:` names a commit that differs from `git rev-parse HEAD`: run `git diff --name-only <Base> HEAD`.
If no listed path is in the governing plan's must-NOT-change list or among the files and tests of the work order about to run, append a `## Status` with the new `Base:` and continue.

If any is, spawn `squad-recon` to re-read those paths and affected dependencies, then append a complete updated map, copying unchanged parts from its earlier entry; only the new entry governs, then `squad-pm` in PLAN mode for a complete new plan attempt, which needs its own grant unless the mode is `full`.
Base: <commit SHA the governing plan was mapped against>
A new plan revision voids a grant made for an earlier one, except in `full` mode.
